input.prompt: Using the reference image as the exact layout template: replace the placeholder heading text '[ Your Heading Goes Here ]' with the plain text Enterprise AI Agents in 2026 (no square brackets, no '[' or ']' characters) in the same magenta color, same bold font style, same size and position between the two vertical accent bars. Keep the 'EVOLVEX · INSIGHT' label, the light pink background, the evolvextechnologies.com footer text, and the evolvex logo in the bottom-right corner exactly as shown, do not alter, move, or duplicate them. Fill the large empty content panel in the middle with a clean premium two-part infographic on a soft light mauve background.
